content: Stop hook does NOT fire on user interrupt (Escape/Ctrl+C). Confirmed both by official docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: 'User interrupt (Escape): Does NOT fire Stop hook. User interrupt skips hooks and returns control immediately') and by GitHub issue #9516 (User Interrupt Hook feature request) describing exactly this gap. Separately, multiple unrelated GitHub issues (#46698, #49309, #14526) report the Escape key itself sometimes failing to register as an interrupt at all (UI-level bug, distinct from the hook gap).
